parameters.content:
## WORKFLOW 1: Incident Intake
**1.** Webhook Trigger (`/webhook/incident-intake`)
**2.** Validate Incident Schema
**3.** Create/Update Incident Context
**4.** Analyze Severity & Risk
**5.** Branch: Check Critical (CRITICAL vs Standard)

## WORKFLOW 2: Critical Response
**1.** Webhook Trigger (`/webhook/critical-response`)
**2.** Check Severity
**3.** If Approved (Human Clearance Gate)
**4.** Allocate Resources
**5.** Trigger Ambulance Workflow (108 EMS CAD Mock)
**6.** Trigger Rescue Team Workflow (SDRF Boat Squad Mock)
**7.** Trigger Drone Workflow
**8.** Update RESQNET

## WORKFLOW 3: Drone Deployment
**1.** Webhook Trigger (`/webhook/drone-deployment`)
**2.** Check Available Drones (Battery & Status)
**3.** Select Available Drone
**4.** Create Recon Mission & Flight Grid
**5.** Update Mission Status (AIRBORNE_PATROL)
**6.** Return Result

## WORKFLOW 4: Emergency Alert
**1.** Webhook Trigger (`/webhook/emergency-alert`)
**2.** Generate CAP Emergency Alert
**3.** Human Approval Gate
**4.** Publish/Simulate Alert (EAS Broadcast Mock)
**5.** Log Alert to Audit Ledger
**6.** Respond: Alert Published
